findings.one_line: The promised observable rank/support/cycle criterion is replaced by generic raw-fiber semialgebraic sampling plus an existential unequal-target query, so the delivered theorem is generic decidability rather than the advertised structural causal classification.

The claimed singular/boundary extension is not positioned against the closest NMF, proxy partial-identification, and probabilities-of-causation comparator results: most listed comparators have no theorem-level relevance/difference discussion, and the stated advance relies on the generic decision reduction rather than a new boundary criterion.
